answer_1.quote: With the aim of overcoming these issues, we propose a new dataset DiscrimEvalGen. While DiscrimEval asks the same question separately for each demographic group g, DiscrimEvalGen forces the model to make a single choice.
answer_1.outputs: model decisions in demographic scenarios, agreement with stereotypical statements, factual recall about countries
